correctness.rationale: Uses Fel 2016 Section 1 three-generator complete-intersection/symmetry conditions: for odd n a=32 and membership is equivalent to symmetry; congruences modulo m,m² with B≤31 eliminate all m≥7, and exact bounded branch checks eliminate m=2..6. For even n pairwise gcd1 forces a redundant generator, whose unique possible redundancy is excluded by modular A≥n−1 and its size upper bound except n=4,6, directly excluded. n=3 reduces to <32,243> with F=7501,g=3751. Exact checker rerun from packaged path confirms finite stages and Apéry computations.
